resources.string:
DEMO SCENARIO · demo trip Mumbai → Doha

IJ 1907 Mumbai → Doha is 95 min late and now lands at 21:10. Your next flight MJ 31 leaves Doha at 21:55. You have 45 min; Doha needs at least 60 min (demo value). You will likely miss MJ 31.

1. Rebooking. One ticket for both flights: go to the airline's transfer desk in Doha and ask to be rebooked; check your ticket's conditions. Separate tickets: contact the second airline now, before you board.

2. Options to ask for (SAMPLE, not live data):
• MJ 33 · tonight 23:50
• MJ 35 · tomorrow 08:15
• A partner airline's next flight

3. Not travelling any more? Ask the airline about a refund of the unused flights. What you get back depends on your fare rules; OnBoard never promises an amount.

4. Waiting overnight? Ask the airline about meals and a hotel, and keep every receipt.

OnBoard never books, cancels or pays for you.
